scripts.ci: node run-audit.mjs && node report-gen.mjs && node check-axe-diff.mjs
scripts.baseline:update: node -e "const f='baseline-axe.json',r=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('audit-output/results.json','utf-8'));const routes=Array.isArray(r.routes)?r.routes:Object.values(r.routes);const v=[];for(const ro of routes)for(const vi of(ro.axeViolations||[]))v.push({route:ro.route,id:vi.id,impact:vi.impact,help:vi.help});require('fs').writeFileSync(f,JSON.stringify({generatedAt:new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10),violations:v},null,2));console.log('Baseline updated:',v.length,'violations')"
